# defined
defined
as n get .nothing
defined @n
as f get .off
defined @f
as missing get .missing
defined @missing
defined-word

# empty
empty
as none get .none
empty @none
as bare get .bare
empty @bare
as tests get .tests
empty @tests
empty @f
empty @n
empty-word

# not
as flag get .flag
not @flag
not @f
not-word true
not-word false
not-word
not-word yes
not @n

# bool and null
bool true
bool false
bool yes
bool
null

# type at a path
type
type .arrays
type ."a.b"
type .nothing
type .flag
type .none
type .bare
type .tests
type .tests[0]
type .nested.depth
type .missing

# option
option arrays replace
option missing replace
option a.b 0
option nothing fallback
option tests fallback
option flag false
option-bare arrays
option-bare missing

# option_is
option_is arrays union
option_is arrays concat
option_is missing
option_is nothing null
option_is flag true
option_is a.b 3

# succeeds and fails
succeeds true
succeeds false
fails true
fails false
succeeds [ 1 -lt 2 ]
fails [ 1 -lt 2 ]
succeeds-reading text grep -q x
fails-reading text grep -q z
succeeds transcript__document_is_list
succeeds @tests transcript__document_is_list
